lines.t: Verse 1
I wake up thankful but my heart feels numb,
Got prayers on my lips but my mind still runs.
I know You’re good, yeah I know it’s true,
But some days it’s hard to feel close to You.
I read the Word but the weight stays heavy,
Faith feels strong but my soul ain’t steady.
I don’t wanna fake joy I don’t feel inside,
I just wanna be honest when I talk to YahuShua.
Pre-Chorus
You see the cracks I try to hide,
You hear the prayers I can’t verbalize.
Chorus
YahuShua, I’m trying to be happy,
But I’m learning joy ain’t just a feeling.
Even when my heart feels empty,
You’re still here, You’re still healing.
I don’t need a perfect life,
I just need Your peace tonight.
Teach me how to trust You fully,
Even when I don’t feel alright.
Verse 2
Faith don’t mean that the pain just goes,
Sometimes it’s walking when the road feels closed.
I talk to You in the dead of night,
Tell You my fears, tell You I’m tired of the fight.
You never said it would all be easy,
You promised You’d never leave me.
So I’ll hold on when my hope feels thin,
‘Cause grace still works where I’m weak within.
Bridge
If joy is deeper than a smile on my face,
Then plant it in me by Your grace.
I’ll wait for the day my heart can see
That You’ve been working quietly.
Final Chorus
YahuShua, I’m learning what happiness means,
It’s not the absence of pain in me.
It’s knowing You’re close when I fall apart,
It’s trusting You with my broken heart.
I don’t need everything to be okay,
I just need You to lead the way.
